; Cloudflare BIND import for k-pax.space
; 1) In Cloudflare DNS: delete old A/AAAA/CNAME/MX that conflict (or Export backup first)
; 2) DNS → Import and Export → Import → upload this file
; 3) Check proxy clouds: orange = proxied, grey = DNS only
;
; Proxied (orange): apex, www, sub, cdn
; DNS only (grey): mail, de, fi, bg, pl + all MX/TXT

$ORIGIN k-pax.space.
$TTL 300

; --- website / panel / CDN (Proxied) ---
@       IN  A  77.221.154.107  ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
www     IN  A  77.221.154.107  ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
sub     IN  A  77.221.154.107  ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
cdn     IN  A  77.221.154.107  ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true

; --- mail origin (DNS only — never orange) ---
mail    IN  A  77.221.154.107  ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:false

; --- node hostnames for spare gRPC/XHTTP (DNS only — never orange) ---
de      IN  A  31.77.116.51    ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:false
fi      IN  A  144.31.169.6    ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:false
bg      IN  A  79.124.7.111    ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:false
pl      IN  A  2.26.225.213    ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:false

; --- mail ---
@       IN  MX  10 mail.k-pax.space.
@       IN  TXT "v=spf1 ip4:77.221.154.107 ~all"
_dmarc  IN  TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:support@k-pax.space"
mail._domainkey IN TXT "v=DKIM1; h=sha256; k=rsa; "
